fact_check_verdict: PASS WITH ATTRIBUTION: ADN is the single outlet for every figure; handbook and catalog verified primary; student quotes and Shier/Dotson quotes CUT

claims.claim: 150 UAA students were cited for academic misconduct.
claims.verbatim_source: Of the 150 students cited for academic misconduct, 119 used AI, accounting for 1.1% of the more than 10,500 students who attended UAA last semester.
claims.label: PER ADN, FROM A UAA DEAN OF STUDENTS REPORT
claims.note: ADN only. No time span for the 150 is given, never state one. Never share a frame with 1.1%.

claims.verbatim_source: Of the 150 students cited for academic misconduct, 119 used AI, accounting for 1.1% of the more than 10,500 students who attended UAA last semester.
claims.label: PER ADN, FROM A UAA DEAN OF STUDENTS REPORT
claims.note: About four in five is our arithmetic.

claims.claim: The 119 AI cases are 1.1% of UAA students who attended last semester.
claims.verbatim_source: Of the 150 students cited for academic misconduct, 119 used AI, accounting for 1.1% of the more than 10,500 students who attended UAA last semester.
claims.label: PER ADN
claims.note: 1.1% belongs to the 119, never to the 150.

claims.claim: The report shows a 73% increase in AI use for plagiarism last year.
claims.verbatim_source: The report shows a 73% increase in AI use for plagiarism last year and a 56% increase in academic misconduct overall.
claims.label: PER ADN, UAA DEAN OF STUDENTS REPORT
claims.note: Last year is undefined, never print a calendar year. 56% is overall misconduct, not AI.

claims.claim: The report says cases involving AI use have taken over the majority of cases addressed by the conduct office.
claims.verbatim_source: cases involving AI use have taken over the majority of cases addressed by the conduct office.
claims.label: UAA DEAN OF STUDENTS REPORT, VIA ADN
claims.note: Speaker is the REPORT, not a person.

claims.claim: UA has no single systemwide AI rule today.
claims.verbatim_source: (ADN reports no single UA-wide AI policy)
claims.label: PER ADN
claims.note: ADN only. Attribute. Paraphrase only, never a verbatim quote.

claims.claim: Faculty set AI rules course by course.
claims.verbatim_source: (ADN reports faculty set AI rules in syllabi)
claims.label: PER ADN

claims.claim: The UAA student handbook's academic integrity section bars utilizing devices not authorized by the faculty member.
claims.verbatim_source: utilizing devices not authorized by the faculty member;
claims.on_screen: "DEVICES NOT AUTHORIZED BY THE FACULTY MEMBER"
claims.label: UAA STUDENT HANDBOOK

claims.claim: That handbook section does not mention AI.
claims.verbatim_source: (the academic integrity page contains no mention of AI)
claims.label: UAA STUDENT HANDBOOK
claims.note: Say it doesn't mention AI, never that AI is banned.

claims.claim: The UA regents have a draft of AI principles.
claims.verbatim_source: presented the draft language to regents in September
claims.label: PER ADN
claims.note: Do not say what the draft contains.

claims.claim: Stephanie Erickson, a special projects lead, presented the draft to regents in September.
claims.verbatim_source: a special projects lead who presented the draft language to regents in September alongside Chief Information Technology Officer Ben Shier.
claims.label: PER ADN
claims.note: Nameplate only, never drawn. Her office is not named by ADN.

claims.claim: Erickson: we need to be deliberate with how we want to engage with AI instead of letting it just happen to us.
claims.verbatim_source: We need to be deliberate with how we want to engage with AI instead of letting it just happen to us.
claims.on_screen: "DELIBERATE ... INSTEAD OF LETTING IT JUST HAPPEN TO US"
claims.label: STEPHANIE ERICKSON · PER ADN
claims.note: Exact wording; the VO may quote the first clause only.

claims.claim: Regents will consider guiding principles for integrating AI throughout the UA system in November.
claims.verbatim_source: Regents will consider guiding principles for integrating AI throughout the UA system in November.
claims.label: PER ADN
claims.note: 'Will consider', never 'will adopt'. Guiding principles are not a binding rule.

claims.claim: UAA lists a Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and Engineering.
claims.verbatim_source: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and Engineering (MS)
claims.on_screen: UAA M.S. IN AI, DATA SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING
claims.label: UAA CATALOG

claims.claim: More than 10,500 students attended UAA last semester.
claims.verbatim_source: the more than 10,500 students who attended UAA last semester
claims.label: PER ADN
claims.note: Do not pair with 150 as a rate.

cut: any calendar year for last year
